<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**6** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **250** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **40** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e9da8987afd23fa2b66e8a141c0585174819f521` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4fe40eec7624ff0f2610fec36da508a0d2b52224` — the merge of head `009ca680a2f59e1a28a705897d37b3540effbd01` into base `e9da8987afd23fa2b66e8a141c0585174819f521`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4fe40eec7624ff0f2610fec36da508a0d2b52224 && git checkout 4fe40eec7624ff0f2610fec36da508a0d2b52224
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e9da8987afd23fa2b66e8a141c0585174819f521 009ca680a2f59e1a28a705897d37b3540effbd01 && git checkout -B drift-repro e9da8987afd23fa2b66e8a141c0585174819f521 && git merge --no-ff 009ca680a2f59e1a28a705897d37b3540effbd01

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e9da8987afd23fa2b66e8a141c0585174819f521
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用命令行安装或更新技能包的开发者:更新中途失败(磁盘满、权限不足、文件被锁)时,原来的技能和安装记录原样保留,再跑一次普通的 `os skills update` 就能装好,不用 `--force`。
- 为什么做:卡 #35079。这个修复原来由 #35495 合入,后来因为门禁里的临时目录扫描判红被 #35616 撤回。你在裁决 7075362923 选了「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」,#36368 已经按这个裁决改好门禁。本 PR 把原修复原样重新合入。
- 出错会怎样:影响只在技能安装和更新两条命令。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。

## 席位核对

- **是不是原样重合**:我用 `git diff 578d3b1d66~1 578d3b1d66` 和 `git diff ff601499 009ca680` 两份补丁做了 `diff`,结果逐字节相同。两个被改的源文件 `skills-install-state.ts` 和 `skills-commands.test.ts`,在 `578d3b1d66~1` 和 `ff601499` 上的 blob 也相同。所以这不只是补丁能打上,而是打在了同一份文件上。PR 只有一个提交,3 个文件。
- **撤回的原因已经解决**:#35616 撤回,是因为 `skills-install-state.ts` 里 `mkdtempSync(join(dir, SKILLS_STAGING_PREFIX))` 的 `dir` 在调用时才决定,扫描读不出来,完整性那一条判红。#36368(已合并,依据裁决 7075362923)把规则改成:发布包源码里这种调用只报告,不判红;测试和仓库脚本照旧判红。我在本 head 的 worktree 里直接调了门禁的导出(`exposedScratchDirs({})` 和 `mkdtempCompleteness`),读数是:exposed 0,failing 0,reported 只有一处 `packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts:246 (dir is not bound in this file)`。和 dev 报告的一致。本 head 上 `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` 也是 success。
- **#35616 提到的忽略规则问题**:被强行中断的运行如果在本仓库根目录下,会留下 `.claude/skills/.objectstack-skills-staging-*`。这正是裁决接受的代价(「发布代码同类调用只报告不判红」),不需要在本 PR 里处理。另外,这个目录以点开头,`status` 不会把它当成技能,下一次写入会把它删掉,测试钉住了这一点。
- **卡片关系**:首行 `Fixes #35079`。这张卡在撤回后重新打开,本 PR 交付了它的全部内容。合并应当关卡。
- **声明**:`Clause-②: no` 对。`SKILLS_STAGING_PREFIX` 是 `utils` 里的常量,不是包根导出。`Metadata-protocol: none` 对。不欠 Skills-docs:命令行为和标志都没变,只改了写入的方式。不是 `!`,也没有 `(narrowing)`,不欠 dogfood。
- **changeset**:`@objectstack/cli` 有 patch 条目,原文是 #35616 删掉的那一份。逐句核过:「先写进暂存目录,再用 rename 换进去,最后写记录」「任何一步失败都按倒序撤回,并报告错误」「普通的 `os skills update` 就能重来」「中断留下的 `.objectstack-skills-staging-*` 是隐藏的,不会被当成技能,下一次写入会删掉」。每一句都和 `applySkillsWrite` 以及新的测试一致。
- **测试**:三种故障点(写第二个技能的文件时、把第二个技能换进去时、写记录时)各注入一次 `ENOSPC`。每种都断言:退出码 1;旧版本的文件和记录原样;`status --check` 干净;旁边只剩记录文件;再跑一次不带 `--force` 的 `update` 就能装上 V2。还有一条测试覆盖中断留下的暂存目录。
- **本地没跑的部分,CI 有没有盖到**:dev 说本地没有跑 cli 的完整单元测试和 cli 的 typecheck。
  - typecheck:本 head 上 `TypeScript Type Check` 和 `Type Check · workspace` 都是 success。
  - 单元测试:`Plan Test Core shards` 的日志写明 `@objectstack/cli` 分成 3 片,在 `Test Core (1/10)`、`(5/10)`、`(6/10)` 里跑。
  - CI 已经覆盖了这两项,所以本地少跑这部分可以接受。
- **CI @ `009ca680`**:37 success、16 skipped、0 failed,其中跑 cli 的三片 Test Core (1/10)、(5/10)、(6/10) 都是 success;不在治理面。
- **落地**:席位落地。
